scope: Finite-dimensional linear representation changes and finite receiver re-encodings. The contract distinguishes similarity, orthogonal/unitary similarity, congruence, coordinate change, and receiver transformation without promoting representation equivalence into semantic, epistemic, empirical, or physical identity.

transform_classes.similarity: B=P^{-1} A P with P invertible
transform_classes.orthogonal_similarity_real: B=Q^T A Q with Q^T Q=I
transform_classes.unitary_similarity_complex: B=U^* A U with U^* U=I
transform_classes.congruence_real: B=P^T A P with P invertible
transform_classes.coordinate_change: v'=P^{-1}v and A'=P^{-1}AP for one abstract vector/operator pair
transform_classes.receiver_reencoding: O'=R o O on the observation codomain; equivalence preservation requires R injective on im(O)

invariant_discipline.rule: Every invariant claim names the transformation class and hypotheses under which it is preserved.
coordinate_change: abstract action relation A(v) represented covariantly

execution_limits.policy: The finite battery is exact conformance evidence for the declared 2x2/Fin3 fixtures only; it is not a substitute for the repository-contained general proofs.

explicit_deferrals: canonical forms beyond the bounded counterexamples
Sylvester inertia theorem as an advertised UFT-ID theorem
empirical coordinate/receiver validity to planned PR #18
